EDU_BEG_004: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_records FROM enrollments;
EDU_BEG_005: SELECT * FROM enrollments ORDER BY course_fee DESC;
EDU_BEG_006: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM courses ORDER BY category;
EDU_BEG_007: SELECT * FROM enrollments WHERE enrollment_date >= DATE '2026-01-01';
EDU_BEG_009: SELECT * FROM students ORDER BY student_id LIMIT 5;
EDU_BEG_010: SELECT * FROM enrollments WHERE course_fee BETWEEN 25000 AND 75000;
EDU_BEG_011: SELECT * FROM students WHERE student_name LIKE 'A%';
EDU_BEG_012: SELECT * FROM enrollments WHERE status IN ('Active','Pending');
EDU_BEG_014: SELECT * FROM assessments WHERE assessment_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30';
EDU_BEG_015: SELECT AVG(course_fee) AS average_amount FROM enrollments;
EDU_BEG_016: SELECT MAX(amount) AS largest_amount FROM assessments;
EDU_BEG_017: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT city) AS city_count FROM students;
EDU_BEG_019: SELECT enrollment_id, course_fee, CASE WHEN course_fee >= 100000 THEN 'High' WHEN course_fee >= 50000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS amount_band FROM enrollments ORDER BY enrollment_id;
EDU_BEG_020: SELECT * FROM enrollments WHERE status = 'Active' AND course_fee >= 50000;
EDU_INT_001: SELECT m.student_name, r.enrollment_id, r.status, r.course_fee FROM students m JOIN enrollments r ON m.student_id=r.student_id ORDER BY m.student_id,r.enrollment_id;
EDU_INT_002: SELECT c.course_name, COUNT(r.enrollment_id) AS record_count FROM courses c LEFT JOIN enrollments r ON c.course_id=r.course_id GROUP BY c.course_id,c.course_name ORDER BY c.course_id;
EDU_INT_003: SELECT r.enrollment_id FROM enrollments r LEFT JOIN assessments e ON r.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.assessment_id IS NULL ORDER BY r.enrollment_id;
EDU_INT_004: SELECT r.enrollment_id, COALESCE(SUM(e.amount),0) AS total_amount FROM enrollments r LEFT JOIN assessments e ON r.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id GROUP BY r.enrollment_id ORDER BY r.enrollment_id;
EDU_INT_005: SELECT r.enrollment_id, SUM(e.amount) AS total_amount FROM enrollments r JOIN assessments e ON r.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id GROUP BY r.enrollment_id HAVING SUM(e.amount)>20000 ORDER BY total_amount DESC;
EDU_INT_006: SELECT m.segment, COUNT(r.enrollment_id) AS record_count FROM students m LEFT JOIN enrollments r ON m.student_id=r.student_id GROUP BY m.segment ORDER BY m.segment;
EDU_INT_007: SELECT c.category, AVG(r.course_fee) AS average_amount FROM courses c JOIN enrollments r ON c.course_id=r.course_id GROUP BY c.category ORDER BY c.category;
EDU_INT_008: SELECT m.student_name, r.enrollment_id, c.course_name, r.status FROM students m JOIN enrollments r ON m.student_id=r.student_id JOIN courses c ON r.course_id=c.course_id ORDER BY r.enrollment_id;
EDU_INT_009: SELECT m.student_id,m.student_name,SUM(r.course_fee) AS total_amount FROM students m JOIN enrollments r ON m.student_id=r.student_id GROUP BY m.student_id,m.student_name ORDER BY total_amount DESC;
EDU_INT_010: SELECT enrollment_id,course_fee FROM enrollments WHERE course_fee>(SELECT AVG(course_fee) FROM enrollments) ORDER BY course_fee DESC;
EDU_INT_011: SELECT e.assessment_id,e.assessment_date,e.assessment_type,e.amount,r.status AS record_status FROM assessments e JOIN enrollments r ON e.enrollment_id=r.enrollment_id ORDER BY e.assessment_id;
EDU_INT_012: SELECT r.enrollment_id,SUM(CASE WHEN e.status='Completed' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) AS completed_amount,SUM(CASE WHEN e.status='Failed' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) AS failed_amount FROM enrollments r LEFT JOIN assessments e ON r.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id GROUP BY r.enrollment_id ORDER BY r.enrollment_id;
EDU_INT_013: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month',assessment_date)::date AS event_month,COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM assessments GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month',assessment_date) ORDER BY event_month;
EDU_INT_014: SELECT m.student_id,m.student_name FROM students m LEFT JOIN enrollments r ON m.student_id=r.student_id WHERE r.enrollment_id IS NULL ORDER BY m.student_id;
EDU_INT_015: SELECT c.course_id,c.course_name FROM courses c LEFT JOIN enrollments r ON c.course_id=r.course_id WHERE r.enrollment_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.course_id;
EDU_INT_016: SELECT m.student_id,m.student_name,MIN(r.enrollment_date) AS first_date FROM students m JOIN enrollments r ON m.student_id=r.student_id GROUP BY m.student_id,m.student_name ORDER BY m.student_id;
EDU_INT_017: SELECT r.enrollment_id,MAX(e.assessment_date) AS latest_event_date FROM enrollments r LEFT JOIN assessments e ON r.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id GROUP BY r.enrollment_id ORDER BY r.enrollment_id;
EDU_INT_018: SELECT DISTINCT m.student_id,m.student_name FROM students m JOIN enrollments r ON m.student_id=r.student_id JOIN assessments e ON r.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id WHERE e.status='Completed' ORDER BY m.student_id;
EDU_INT_019: SELECT c.category,AVG(e.amount) AS average_event_amount FROM courses c JOIN enrollments r ON c.course_id=r.course_id JOIN assessments e ON r.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id GROUP BY c.category ORDER BY c.category;
EDU_INT_020: SELECT m.segment,r.status,COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM students m JOIN enrollments r ON m.student_id=r.student_id GROUP BY m.segment,r.status ORDER BY m.segment,r.status;
EDU_EXP_001: WITH totals AS (SELECT m.student_id,m.student_name,SUM(e.amount) total_amount FROM students m JOIN enrollments r ON m.student_id=r.student_id JOIN assessments e ON r.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id GROUP BY m.student_id,m.student_name) SELECT student_id,student_name,total_amount,RANK() OVER(ORDER BY total_amount DESC) AS amount_rank FROM totals ORDER BY amount_rank,student_id;
EDU_EXP_002: SELECT r.enrollment_id,MAX(e.assessment_date) AS latest_event_date FROM enrollments r LEFT JOIN assessments e ON r.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id GROUP BY r.enrollment_id HAVING MAX(e.assessment_date)<DATE '2026-01-01' OR MAX(e.assessment_date) IS NULL ORDER BY r.enrollment_id;
EDU_EXP_003: WITH totals AS (SELECT student_id,SUM(course_fee) total_amount FROM enrollments GROUP BY student_id) SELECT student_id,total_amount FROM totals WHERE total_amount>(SELECT AVG(total_amount) FROM totals) ORDER BY total_amount DESC;
EDU_EXP_004: SELECT enrollment_id,course_fee,CASE WHEN course_fee>=100000 THEN 'High' WHEN course_fee>=50000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END amount_band FROM enrollments ORDER BY enrollment_id;
EDU_EXP_005: WITH monthly AS (SELECT enrollment_id,DATE_TRUNC('month',assessment_date)::date event_month,SUM(amount) monthly_amount FROM assessments GROUP BY enrollment_id,DATE_TRUNC('month',assessment_date)) SELECT enrollment_id,event_month,monthly_amount,LAG(monthly_amount) OVER(PARTITION BY enrollment_id ORDER BY event_month) previous_month_amount FROM monthly ORDER BY enrollment_id,event_month;
EDU_EXP_006: SELECT enrollment_id,assessment_id,assessment_date,amount,SUM(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY enrollment_id ORDER BY assessment_date,assessment_id) running_amount FROM assessments ORDER BY enrollment_id,assessment_date,assessment_id;
EDU_EXP_007: WITH ranked AS (SELECT e.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY enrollment_id ORDER BY amount DESC,assessment_id) rn FROM assessments e) SELECT assessment_id,enrollment_id,amount FROM ranked WHERE rn<=2 ORDER BY enrollment_id,rn;
EDU_EXP_008: WITH totals AS (SELECT r.enrollment_id,COALESCE(SUM(e.amount),0) total_amount FROM enrollments r LEFT JOIN assessments e ON r.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id GROUP BY r.enrollment_id) SELECT enrollment_id,total_amount,ROUND(100.0*total_amount/NULLIF(SUM(total_amount) OVER(),0),2) percent_of_total FROM totals ORDER BY enrollment_id;
EDU_EXP_009: SELECT student_id,enrollment_id,course_fee,DENSE_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY course_fee DESC) amount_rank FROM enrollments ORDER BY student_id,amount_rank,enrollment_id;
EDU_EXP_010: SELECT enrollment_id,assessment_id,assessment_date,amount,LAG(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY enrollment_id ORDER BY assessment_date,assessment_id) previous_amount FROM assessments ORDER BY enrollment_id,assessment_date,assessment_id;
EDU_EXP_011: SELECT enrollment_id,assessment_id,assessment_date,amount,AVG(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY enrollment_id ORDER BY assessment_date,assessment_id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) moving_average FROM assessments ORDER BY enrollment_id,assessment_date,assessment_id;
EDU_EXP_012: SELECT m.student_id,m.student_name FROM students m WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM enrollments r WHERE r.student_id=m.student_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM enrollments r WHERE r.student_id=m.student_id AND r.status<>'Active') ORDER BY m.student_id;
EDU_EXP_013: SELECT enrollment_id,status,course_fee FROM enrollments r WHERE course_fee>(SELECT AVG(x.course_fee) FROM enrollments x WHERE x.status=r.status) ORDER BY status,course_fee DESC;
EDU_EXP_014: SELECT r.enrollment_id,MIN(e.assessment_date) first_event,MAX(e.assessment_date) last_event,MAX(e.assessment_date)-MIN(e.assessment_date) active_days FROM enrollments r JOIN assessments e ON r.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id GROUP BY r.enrollment_id ORDER BY r.enrollment_id;
EDU_EXP_015: SELECT assessment_id,enrollment_id,amount,ROUND(100.0*amount/NULLIF(SUM(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY enrollment_id),0),2) record_percent FROM assessments ORDER BY enrollment_id,assessment_id;
EDU_EXP_016: WITH totals AS (SELECT m.student_id,m.student_name,m.segment,SUM(r.course_fee) total_amount FROM students m JOIN enrollments r ON m.student_id=r.student_id GROUP BY m.student_id,m.student_name,m.segment), ranked AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY total_amount DESC,student_id) rn FROM totals) SELECT student_id,student_name,segment,total_amount FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY segment;
EDU_EXP_017: SELECT assessment_id,enrollment_id,amount FROM assessments e WHERE amount>(SELECT AVG(x.amount) FROM assessments x WHERE x.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id) ORDER BY enrollment_id,amount DESC;
EDU_EXP_018: WITH counts AS (SELECT m.student_id,m.student_name,COUNT(r.enrollment_id) record_count FROM students m LEFT JOIN enrollments r ON m.student_id=r.student_id GROUP BY m.student_id,m.student_name) SELECT student_id,student_name,record_count FROM counts WHERE record_count>(SELECT AVG(record_count) FROM counts) ORDER BY record_count DESC,student_id;
EDU_EXP_019: SELECT r.enrollment_id,SUM(CASE WHEN e.status='Completed' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) completed_amount,SUM(CASE WHEN e.status='Pending' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) pending_amount,SUM(CASE WHEN e.status='Failed' THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END) failed_amount FROM enrollments r LEFT JOIN assessments e ON r.enrollment_id=e.enrollment_id GROUP BY r.enrollment_id ORDER BY r.enrollment_id;
EDU_EXP_020: WITH ranked AS (SELECT e.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY enrollment_id ORDER BY assessment_date DESC,assessment_id DESC) rn FROM assessments e) SELECT assessment_id,enrollment_id,assessment_date,assessment_type,amount,status FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY enrollment_id;
